description_en: Queries information about an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 MongoDB 实例的信息
name: DescribeDBInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en: The database engine. Set the value to MongoDB
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group. For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html.
Currently, only the China site supports this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。资源组详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html。
目前仅中国站支持配置该参数
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the instance is deleted. Valid values:
false: The instance is running. Queries information about running instances.
true: The instance is deleted. Queries information about deleted instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否已删除，取值说明： 
false：实例正常运行，查询运行中实例信息。
true：实例已删除，查询被删除实例的信息
parameters.name: is_delete
